name: Hangu Pass (Qin)
guards: Eastern gate of Qin and Guanzhong
summary: A narrow defile in the loess between the Yellow River and the Qinling hills; for a century the eastern states' armies broke against it. After the Han moved the pass east (114 BCE) and Tong Pass took over (196), the old site remained a famous landmark.
summary_zh: 黄河与崤山之间的深谷窄道，“一夫当关，万夫莫开”。相传老子西出函谷关，应关令尹喜之请著《道德经》。战国时东方诸国多次合纵攻秦，都止步于此。汉代关址东移、东汉末潼关兴起后，旧关成为名胜古迹。

battles.name: Laozi writes the Daodejing for the gatekeeper Yin Xi (legend)
battles.name_zh: 老子出关，为尹喜著《道德经》（传说）

battles.name: Coalition of five states repulsed
battles.name_zh: 五国合纵攻秦，败于函谷

battles.name: Last coalition against Qin fails
battles.name_zh: 最后一次合纵攻秦失败

name: Hangu Pass (Han)
guards: Eastern approach to Luoyang and Chang'an
guards_zh: 洛阳以西、关中东出要道
summary: Moved east to Xin'an in 114 BCE, it is said because a general wanted his home to count as 'within the pass'.
summary_zh: 公元前114年东移至新安，相传因楼船将军杨仆耻为“关外民”而请迁。东汉为洛阳八关之一。

name: Tong Pass
guards: Main gate between the North China Plain and Guanzhong
summary: Built at the end of the Eastern Han where the Yellow River turns east; from then on the key to Chang'an from the east.
summary_zh: 东汉末年设于黄河拐弯处，取代函谷关成为关中东门。“潼关失则长安危”。

battles.name: Cao Cao defeats Ma Chao
battles.name_zh: 曹操破马超（潼关之战）

battles.name: Geshu Han's army destroyed; An Lushan takes Chang'an
battles.name_zh: 哥舒翰出关兵败，长安失守

battles.name: Li Zicheng breaks the Ming defence
battles.name_zh: 李自成破潼关，孙传庭战死

name: Wu Pass
guards: Southeast gate of Guanzhong, toward Chu
guards_zh: 关中东南门户、通南阳与楚地
summary: On the Dan River route from Guanzhong to Nanyang and the middle Yangtze; one of the 'four passes' of Qin.
summary_zh: 秦“四塞”之一，扼丹江谷道，通南阳、荆楚。

battles.name: King Huai of Chu lured to Wu Pass and seized
battles.name_zh: 楚怀王被诱入武关遭扣留

battles.name: Liu Bang enters Guanzhong through Wu Pass
battles.name_zh: 刘邦由武关入关中

name: Xiao Pass
guards: Northwest gate of Guanzhong against the steppe
guards_zh: 关中西北门户、防北方游牧
summary: Guarded the Jing River road from the Ordos and Gansu into Guanzhong; one of the 'four passes'.
summary_zh: 秦“四塞”之一，扼泾水河谷，防匈奴等南下关中。唐诗多咏萧关。

battles.name: Xiongnu break through and raid toward Chang'an
battles.name_zh: 匈奴老上单于入萧关，烽火通甘泉

name: Dasan Pass
guards: Southwest gate of Guanzhong, road to Hanzhong and Shu
guards_zh: 关中西南门户、通汉中巴蜀
summary: Where the Chencang road crosses the Qinling to Hanzhong; one of the 'four passes'.
summary_zh: 秦“四塞”之一，陈仓道越秦岭入汉中处。陆游“铁马秋风大散关”。

battles.name: Han Xin's secret march by Chencang
battles.name_zh: 暗度陈仓

battles.name: Wu Jie halts the Jin at Heshangyuan
battles.name_zh: 吴玠和尚原大破金兵

name: Pujin Pass
guards: Yellow River crossing between Shanxi and Guanzhong
summary: A fortified crossing of the Yellow River; under the Tang an iron-chain pontoon bridge held by giant iron oxen spanned it here.
summary_zh: 黄河重要渡口。唐开元年间铸铁牛系浮桥，铁牛今已出土。

name: Hulao Pass
guards: Eastern gate of Luoyang
summary: Also called Sishui Pass; a loess bluff above the Yellow River on the road from the plain to Luoyang.
summary_zh: 又名汜水关、成皋，扼黄河南岸东西大道，为洛阳东门。

battles.name: Liu Bang and Xiang Yu stalemate at Chenggao
battles.name_zh: 楚汉相持成皋

battles.name: Li Shimin captures Dou Jiande
battles.name_zh: 李世民虎牢之战擒窦建德

name: Yique Pass
guards: Southern gate of Luoyang
summary: The 'gate' cut by the Yi River south of Luoyang, one of the eight passes set in 184 against the Yellow Turbans; the Longmen caves line its cliffs.
summary_zh: 伊水两山对峙如阙，东汉为防黄巾设“洛阳八关”之一。龙门石窟即开凿于此。

battles.name: Bai Qi destroys the Han-Wei army
battles.name_zh: 白起伊阙之战大破韩魏

name: Jianmen Pass
guards: Northern gate of Sichuan
summary: A cleft in the sheer cliffs of the Jianmen range on the Shu road; 'one man guards it, ten thousand cannot pass' (Li Bai).
summary_zh: 大小剑山间断崖如门，诸葛亮设阁道守之。李白“一夫当关，万夫莫开”。

battles.name: Jiang Wei holds Zhong Hui at Jiange
battles.name_zh: 姜维据剑阁拒钟会

name: Yangping Pass
guards: Western gate of Hanzhong
summary: Key to the Hanzhong basin from the west and north; the contest for Hanzhong turned on it.
summary_zh: 汉中盆地西部门户，三国时争夺汉中的关键。

battles.name: Cao Cao defeats Zhang Lu
battles.name_zh: 曹操阳平关破张鲁

battles.name: Liu Bei takes Hanzhong (Mount Dingjun nearby)
battles.name_zh: 刘备夺汉中，定军山斩夏侯渊

name: Qutang Pass
guards: Upper Yangtze gorge between Shu and Chu
summary: At Kuimen, the entrance of the Three Gorges; whoever held it controlled the river route between Sichuan and the middle Yangtze.
summary_zh: 夔门天下雄，扼长江三峡西口，为川楚水路咽喉。

battles.name: Liu Bei retreats to Baidi after Yiling
battles.name_zh: 夷陵败后刘备退守白帝城

name: Wusheng Pass
guards: Road between the Huai plain and the Han River
summary: One of the 'three passes of Yiyang' through the Dabie and Tongbai hills, on the main road from Henan to Wuhan.
summary_zh: “义阳三关”之一，扼大别山、桐柏山之间南北孔道。

name: Jingxing Pass
guards: Taihang crossing between Shanxi and the Hebei plain
guards_zh: 太行八陉之一、晋冀通道
summary: One of the eight passages (陉) through the Taihang; also called Tumen Pass.
summary_zh: 太行八陉之第五陉，又称土门关，连通山西与河北平原。

battles.name: Han Xin's battle with his back to the river
battles.name_zh: 韩信背水之战破赵

name: Tianjing Pass
guards: Taihang crossing from Shangdang to Luoyang
summary: On the Taihang road from the Shangdang uplands down to the Yellow River and Luoyang.
summary_zh: 又名太行关，自上党南下河内、洛阳的要道。

name: Niangzi Pass
guards: Eastern gate of Shanxi
summary: Said to be named for Princess Pingyang, sister of Tang Taizong, whose 'Lady's Army' held it.
summary_zh: 相传因唐平阳公主率“娘子军”驻守得名，为晋东门户。

name: Yanmen Pass
guards: Northern gate of Shanxi against the steppe
summary: Guarding the Juzhu mountains between Datong and Taiyuan; 'the first pass of the world' to the Tang.
summary_zh: 扼勾注山，自大同南下太原必经之地，号“天下九塞，雁门为首”。

battles.name: Emperor Yang of Sui besieged by the Turks
battles.name_zh: 隋炀帝雁门被围

battles.name: Yang Ye's last campaign against the Liao
battles.name_zh: 杨业抗辽

name: Pingxing Pass
guards: Inner Great Wall between Shanxi and Hebei
summary: A gate in the Ming inner Great Wall on the road east from Datong.
summary_zh: 明内长城关口，扼大同东去要道。

name: Ningwu Pass
guards: One of the 'outer three passes' of Shanxi
summary: Ming fortress between Yanmen and Pianguan; with them the 'outer three passes'.
summary_zh: 明代与雁门、偏关合称“外三关”。

battles.name: Zhou Yuji's last stand against Li Zicheng
battles.name_zh: 周遇吉死守宁武关

name: Pianguan
guards: Where the Great Wall meets the Yellow River
summary: Westernmost of the outer three passes, where the Wall comes down to the Yellow River bend.
summary_zh: 外三关之一，长城在此临黄河。

name: Shahu Pass
guards: Great Wall gate to Mongolia (later a trade gate)
summary: Ming 'Kill the Hu' gate; under the Qing a customs post on the road of Shanxi migrants 'going west' to Inner Mongolia.
summary_zh: 明称杀胡口，清改杀虎口，成为“走西口”通道和税关。

name: Zhangjiakou
guards: Great Wall gate on the tea road to Mongolia
guards_zh: 长城关口、张库大道起点
summary: Ming fort and horse market; later the start of the tea caravans to Kyakhta.
summary_zh: 明设堡与马市，清为张库商道起点。

name: Juyong Pass
guards: Northwest gate of Beijing
summary: A 20-km gorge through the Jundu hills, the main road from the Mongolian plateau to Beijing.
summary_zh: 军都山中长约二十公里的关沟，北京西北屏障。

battles.name: Mongols break through to Zhongdu
battles.name_zh: 蒙古破居庸关围中都

battles.name: Li Zicheng enters, Beijing falls
battles.name_zh: 李自成入居庸关，北京陷落

name: Zijing Pass
guards: One of Beijing's 'inner three passes'
summary: With Juyong and Daoma, one of the inner three passes shielding Beijing from the west.
summary_zh: 与居庸、倒马合称“内三关”。

battles.name: Esen breaks through after Tumu
battles.name_zh: 土木之变后也先破紫荆关逼北京

name: Daoma Pass
guards: Inner three passes, southwest of Beijing
summary: 'Horse-tumbling pass', so steep that horses fell on it.
summary_zh: 山路险峻，马行至此常跌倒，故名。

name: Gubeikou
guards: Northeast gate of Beijing toward Rehe
summary: Gate in the wall on the road from Beijing to the Rehe uplands and Manchuria.
summary_zh: 北京通往热河、东北的要口。

battles.name: Altan Khan raids to Beijing (Gengxu crisis)
battles.name_zh: 庚戌之变，俺答由古北口入犯

name: Xifengkou
guards: Great Wall gate on the Luan River
summary: Where the Luan River valley cuts the wall, a route between the Hebei plain and the Liao lands.
summary_zh: 滦河穿长城处，通辽西、蒙古。

battles.name: Hong Taiji raids through the wall to Beijing
battles.name_zh: 己巳之变，皇太极破长城入关

name: Shanhai Pass
guards: Where the Great Wall meets the sea; gate to Manchuria
summary: Built by Xu Da in 1381 between the Yan hills and the Bohai: 'the first pass under heaven'.
summary_zh: 1381年徐达所筑，依山傍海，号“天下第一关”。

battles.name: Wu Sangui lets the Qing through; Li Zicheng defeated
battles.name_zh: 吴三桂引清兵入关，一片石之战败李自成

name: Waqiao Pass
guards: Song frontier against the Liao
summary: One of the three river passes Emperor Shizong of Later Zhou took from the Liao; under the Song, the front line held with flooded paddies.
summary_zh: 后周世宗北伐收复的“三关”之一，北宋以塘泺水网据守防辽。

battles.name: Later Zhou retakes the three passes
battles.name_zh: 周世宗北伐取三关

name: Jade Gate
guards: Han gate to the Western Regions (northern road)
summary: Westernmost gate of the Han wall, through which jade from Khotan came; the Tang gate later moved east near Guazhou.
summary_zh: 汉长城西端关口，西域和田玉由此入关；唐代关址东移至瓜州附近。王之涣“春风不度玉门关”。

battles.name: Ban Chao asks to return 'alive through the Jade Gate'
battles.name_zh: 班超“但愿生入玉门关”

name: Yang Pass
guards: Han gate to the Western Regions (southern road)
summary: South of the Jade Gate, the start of the southern Silk Road along the Kunlun.
summary_zh: 玉门关之南，丝路南道起点。王维“西出阳关无故人”。

name: Jiayu Pass
guards: Western end of the Ming Great Wall
summary: Built in 1372 in the Hexi Corridor's narrowest point; the end of China proper for Ming travellers.
summary_zh: 1372年建于河西走廊最窄处，明长城西起点，号“天下雄关”。

name: Iron Gate Pass
guards: Gorge on the Silk Road north of Korla
summary: A Tang pass in the Konqi River gorge between Karashahr and Korla.
summary_zh: 唐设于孔雀河峡谷，焉耆与库尔勒之间。

name: Mei Pass
guards: Dayu ridge road between Jiangxi and Guangdong
summary: Zhang Jiuling cut a road over the Dayu ridge in 716; the Song built the gate. The main road to Guangzhou for a thousand years.
summary_zh: 716年张九龄开凿大庾岭路，宋代立关。此后千年为岭南通中原主道。

name: Xianxia Pass
guards: Mountain road between Zhejiang and Fujian
summary: Huang Chao's rebels cut a road through the Xianxia hills into Fujian in 878.
summary_zh: 878年黄巢军开仙霞岭路入闽，为浙闽咽喉。

name: Kunlun Pass
guards: Northern gate of Yongzhou (Nanning)
summary: Guarding the road into the Nanning basin.
summary_zh: 扼邕州北面通道。

battles.name: Di Qing's night attack defeats Nong Zhigao
battles.name_zh: 狄青夜袭昆仑关破侬智高

name: Zhennan Pass
guards: Border gate to Vietnam
summary: On the road from Guangxi to Hanoi; today's Friendship Pass.
summary_zh: 广西通安南的边关，今友谊关。

battles.name: Feng Zicai defeats the French
battles.name_zh: 冯子材镇南关大捷
